faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.body:
Can we get food funded?

No. Food costs are not funded, full stop. Build your budget around other expenses.

How long until we hear back?

The Senate contacts you within 1–2 days to schedule your presentation, and decisions typically arrive within 2–3 weeks of your submission. You'll get the decision by email.

Can organizations outside College Nine apply?

Yes. Per the Constitution, outside organizations can request up to $200. If you need more, include detailed written justification with your request — without it, the request is returned for revision.

Do we really have to present in person?

Yes. Every request includes a 3–5 minute visual presentation at a weekly Senate meeting — Thursdays, 6:00–7:30pm, in Social Sciences 1, Room 261. It's short, and it's your best chance to make the case for your idea.

What makes a strong presentation?

An itemized budget, a clear picture of who benefits, realistic attendance numbers, and a visible connection to College Nine. Keep slides simple and speak to the "why," not just the "what."

Can we ask for travel funding?

Typically not — travel costs are only considered when at least 25% of attendees are College Nine affiliates.

Are costumes covered?

Typically not. If costumes are central to your event, plan to cover them another way.

Does our event have to involve College Nine students?

Yes. Every funded event must allow at least one College Nine affiliate to participate or be present.

Can we reapply after a denial?

Yes. A denial isn't the end — you can revise and submit a new request. If your request was returned for revision (for example, an over-limit request without written justification), fix the issue and resubmit.

Who do we contact with questions?

Email c9senate@ucsc.edu. We'd rather answer a question before you submit than return a request after.

how-to-request.title: How to Request Funding
how-to-request.body:
Requesting funding takes one form and one short presentation. Here's the full path from idea to decision.

Step 1: Check the guidelines

Before anything else, skim the funding guidelines. A few things — like food costs — can't be funded, and knowing that up front saves everyone time.

Step 2: Submit the form

Fill out the funding request form on this site. Requests are reviewed in the order they come in, so submit as early as you can — especially if your event has a fixed date. Since decisions take 2–3 weeks, aim to submit at least 4 weeks before your event.

Requesting more than $200 as an outside organization? That's allowed — just include a detailed written justification for the amount with your request. Without one, the request is returned for revision, which costs you a week or two.

Step 3: We contact you

Within 1–2 days, the Senate will email you to schedule your presentation at an upcoming meeting.

Step 4: Present at a Senate meeting

Prepare a 3–5 minute visual presentation about your request. You'll give it at a weekly Senate meeting:

  • When: Thursdays, 6:00–7:30pm
  • Where: Social Sciences 1, Room 261

Keep it simple. Tell us what you're planning, who it's for, what it costs, and how it connects to College Nine.

What makes a strong presentation

  • A clear, itemized budget — where each dollar goes
  • Who benefits, and how College Nine affiliates are included
  • Realistic numbers for attendance and costs
  • Slides or visuals that support your points instead of repeating them

Step 5: Get your decision

Decisions typically arrive within 2–3 weeks of your submission, by email.

Questions at any step? Email c9senate@ucsc.edu.

home.title: College Nine Senate Funding
home.body:
Got an event, a project, or a program that could use some money? That's what we're here for. The College Nine Senate funds student ideas — yours included.

Who can apply: any UCSC student organization, whether or not you're based at College Nine. Outside organizations can request up to $200 (more is possible with written justification), and every funded event needs at least one College Nine affiliate able to take part.

How it works

  1. Submit a request using the form on this site.
  2. We reach out within 1–2 days to schedule your presentation.
  3. You present for 3–5 minutes at a weekly Senate meeting.
  4. You get a decision by email, typically within 2–3 weeks.

That's the whole process. No hidden steps, no paperwork maze.

Before you apply

  • Read the funding guidelines — a few minutes now saves you a resubmission later.
  • Check the step-by-step guide so you know what to prepare.
  • Curious where the money goes? See our transparency page.

When we meet

Senate meetings happen every Thursday, 6:00–7:30pm in Social Sciences 1, Room 261. Everyone is welcome to attend.

Questions?

Email us at c9senate@ucsc.edu. We're students too — we'll give you a straight answer.

transparency-intro.title: Funding Transparency
transparency-intro.body:
Your student fees fund this budget, so you deserve to see where every dollar goes. This page shows the numbers, updated as the Senate allocates funds.

Figures shown are sample data pending Senate board approval.

What you'll find here

  • This year's budget — the total the Senate has to work with
  • Total spent — what's been awarded so far
  • Remaining funds — what's still available to request
  • Awards by organization — every funded group and the amount they received

Why we publish this

Open books keep the process fair. When you can see what's been funded and what's left, you can time your request better and set a realistic budget — and you can hold us accountable.

Spot something that looks off, or have a question about an award? Email c9senate@ucsc.edu.

funding-guidelines.title: Funding Guidelines
funding-guidelines.body:
Read this before you submit. It's short, and it covers everything that can hold a request up.

What we can't fund

  • Food costs are not funded. No exceptions — plan your budget without them.
  • Costume expenses are typically not funded.
  • Travel costs are typically not considered unless at least 25% of attendees are College Nine affiliates.

What every event needs

All funded events must allow at least one College Nine affiliate to participate or be present. If your event is closed to College Nine students, we can't fund it.

Request limits

Per the Constitution, organizations outside College Nine may request up to $200.

Want to request more than that? You'll need to include detailed written justification with your request. Without it, the request is returned to you for revision — which means a delay, so include it the first time.

Tips for a smooth review

  • Itemize your budget. Lump sums raise questions; line items answer them.
  • Show the College Nine connection clearly — who from C9 benefits, attends, or participates.
  • Submit early. Requests are reviewed in the order received, and decisions typically take 2–3 weeks.

Not sure whether your expense qualifies? Ask before you submit: c9senate@ucsc.edu.
